hardness_axes.name: Discover
hardness_axes.reasoning: Symptoms-only framing hides which interaction breaks invariants; the agent must execute the seeded scenario matrix and read how snapshot timing, replay encode/decode, and reconnect catch-up interleave. Honest instructions stay clear of naming the defective branch.

hardness_axes.name: Synthesize
hardness_axes.reasoning: A coherent fix spans replay byte semantics, predicted-input rollback reconciliation, RNG draw scheduling, and reconnect fast-forward; each area has locally plausible code that still fails global hashes until composed correctly.

hardness_axes.name: Diagnose
hardness_axes.reasoning: Public contract describes divergent hashes/traces after reconnect or replay resume while straight-through runs agree; root causes are inferred from cross-scenario evidence, not disclosed as a single missing field.

hardness_axes.name: Navigate coupling
hardness_axes.reasoning: Authoring mandates at least two mechanistically distinct mistakes whose repairs interfere (e.g., snapshot boundary policy interacts with replay default inputs and catch-up RNG consumption), so local patches predictably break another matrix cell until integrated.

hardness_axes.name: Reason beyond training
hardness_axes.reasoning: Hardness is not 'implement GGPO from a blog'; it is diagnosing ordering and semantic-default mismatches across this engine's bespoke merge and staging rules, which are not recoverable from a single canonical textbook walkthrough.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Disclosure-collapse
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Listing every verifier-checked observable still does not specify the mistaken ordering or defaulting policy; the remaining work is code-directed integration debugging rather than translating a disclosed policy table.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Hidden-instance
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: No 'which of 400 manifests is wrong' gimmick; failures reproduce on a structured multi-seed harness with multiple interaction paths, not a single hidden artifact ID.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Single-artifact repair
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Variant 2 explicitly requires at least two independent defect mechanisms wired so any single-field or single-hunk fix leaves at least one scenario failing (partial-oracle must not pass full suite).

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Generalization
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Verifier covers multiple seeds and disjoint stress paths (reconnect, prediction rollback bursts, replay export/import, resume), so solutions must generalize rather than memorizing one demo trace.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Prompt-honesty
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Honest symptoms-only wording does not reveal which mechanism is wrong; naming it would slide into cause-revealing specificity and is excluded by the public contract.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Cheating-vs-difficulty
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Anti-cheating is limited to deterministic harness inputs/outputs; difficulty comes from true cross-layer inconsistency, not obscurity or tool bans.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Mechanical-fix filter
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Remaining risks are conceptual (collapse), not reward-footer or dependency trivia.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Localized-fix
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Defects are authored across separate roots (replay codec, rollback/prediction merge, reconnect bootstrap/RNG facade) with shared types so grep-obvious single-function surgery cannot satisfy every invariant simultaneously.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Oracle-locality
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Environment floor is 25+ non-Docker files across gameplay, net, replay, tests fixtures, and shared headers; oracle is specified as coordinated surgical edits plus small additive helpers rather than wholesale replacement of one 40-line file.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Small declarative-cluster
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Core challenge is not flipping a manifest knob cluster; it is behavioral consistency across procedural simulation and binary-ish replay artifacts.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Grep-collapse
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Neutral engineering names and symptoms-only instructions avoid mapping prompt nouns directly onto a uniquely labeled buggy helper.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Pre-factored-helper
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: No helpers named after verifier bullets; responsibilities mirror plausible production modules (transport framing, tick driver, stage graph), not benchmark stubs.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Recipe-discount
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Discounted cookbook steps only solve isolated subproblems; passing requires composing them with engine-specific staging timelines and replay semantic defaults, so residual work is integration reasoning rather than recipe transcription.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Security-aura discount
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: No exploitation narrative inflation; difficulty is mundane-but-critical multiplayer integrity.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Orthogonal-checklist
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Repairs trade replay byte identity against live resync correctness and prediction rollback soundness; independent checklist edits should fail at least one required scenario until reconciled.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Harness-discount
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Seeded matrices increase confidence but do not substitute for reading code; they provide evidence channels, not answers.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: One-pass solvability
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Coupled defects plus cross-root invariants make it unlikely a single-pass edit without executing scenarios can satisfy every hash/traces constraint; the harness is needed to falsify partial theories.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Hard-only gate
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: Structurally this is a hard-intent task: symptoms-only public contract, multi-root coupling, and explicit anti-collapse authoring rules; empirical Opus trials validate realization later, but the idea is not medium-by-design.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Information delta test
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: information_delta lists three concrete codebase discoveries (timing/snapshot alignment vs input merge, replay semantic defaults vs prediction timeline, catch-up RNG consumption order) not stated in instruction.md.

anti_trivialization_checks.name: Instruction specificity test
anti_trivialization_checks.reasoning: instruction_specificity.level is symptoms-only, matching the hard-only Step 2a gate.

rubric_axes.name: Verifiable
rubric_axes.reasoning: Deterministic headless matches with state hashes and structured trace slices yield objective scoring across seeds.

rubric_axes.name: Well-specified
rubric_axes.reasoning: Scenario matrix, artifact paths, and hash/trace contracts can be pinned in output_contract.toml without turning instruction.md into an implementation spec.

rubric_axes.name: Solvable
rubric_axes.reasoning: Bounded synthetic engine scope keeps an expert investigation finite once the module boundaries exist.

rubric_axes.name: Difficult
rubric_axes.reasoning: Variant 2 adds explicit multi-mechanism entanglement, partial-oracle discrimination requirements, and 25+ file environment floor so realized difficulty is not accidental single-hunk trivia.

rubric_axes.name: Interesting
rubric_axes.reasoning: Reconnect/replay determinism failures are paid engineering time in real shipped multiplayer systems.

rubric_axes.name: Outcome-verified
rubric_axes.reasoning: Grade hashes, traces, and replay round-trip compatibility—not editor choice or narrative explanation quality.

instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Symptoms-only instructions cannot supply the mistaken timelines and defaults; solving requires deep engagement with the seeded codebase and harness outputs.

information_delta.item: Whether snapshots are captured before or after predicted remote inputs are merged depends on frame/tick alignment in the driver; divergence fingerprints show state skew only on resume paths, implicating boundary placement rather than RNG constants.
information_delta.source_area: tick driver + snapshot writer + input staging
information_delta.why_non_trivial: Instruction.md can honestly report resume divergence without stating merge order; confirming it requires reading scheduling code and correlating with trace frame ids.

information_delta.item: Replay decode reconstructs missing late frames using semantic defaults that are consistent for export but disagree with live prediction reconciliation after reconnect, producing identical RNG streams yet divergent entity states.
information_delta.why_non_trivial: A naive agent may chase RNG reseeding; ruling that out needs comparing input timelines and defaulting tables across codec vs sim, not a single constant search.

information_delta.item: Reconnect catch-up replays staged inputs through a fast-forward path that advances RNG draws at different granularities than steady-state ticks even when session seeds match, so post-reconnect worlds fork despite bitwise-equal seed headers.
information_delta.why_non_trivial: Seeds alone are insufficient; the agent must trace call order and draw counts across catch-up vs normal tick paths discovered in code.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Public narrative stays at observed desync after reconnect/replay resume with deterministic straight-through play; it names required artifacts (hashes/traces/replay files) but not broken functions, fields, or branch predicates.

attack_path.summary: Primary exploit remains an over-eager agent that guesses one famous netcode bug pattern without falsifying alternatives; secondary exploit is reading test-only hints if Step 2b leaks them.
attack_path.reasoning: Mitigations already in variant: neutral naming, split mechanisms, tests that fail on partial fixes, and verifier focus on multi-scenario hashes rather than error-string grepping.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: After variant-2 constraints, the smallest successful real patch should span multiple modules (types + codec + driver/bootstrap), not a one-line constant tweak.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: If empirical authoring still allows a tinier patch, partial-oracle simulation and trial logs must force widening before submission; smallest plausible success is now intentionally multi-site.

collapse_audit.reasoning: Smallest-successful-patch risk is explicitly designed down via entangled defects and environment breadth; remaining concern is execution quality during Step 2b, not intrinsic one-bullet collapse of the idea family.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: Once built, the hard work is building a joint model of timeline semantics across replay bytes, prediction rollback, and reconnect catch-up so all scenario hashes agree—integration debugging with falsifiable hypotheses from traces.
